updates.ограничения: Publisher Methods defines SCS success as at least 50% pain relief from the trial and subsequent implant. Results reports 945 included in analysis and Table 1 partitions 826 SCS successes and 119 failures later treated with TDD, but no model-specific complete-case denominator or fixed follow-up horizon is stated. The article mentions cross-validation without a split unit or proof of patient-disjointness. This is single-center derivation, not external validation; no ECAP.
